recognize_zh: 淋巴結切片左側為密集小淋巴球，右側為大而淡染、有核分裂與凋亡碎屑的反應性生發中心；小淋巴球區內散在小群淡嗜伊紅的類上皮組織球（epithelioid histiocytes），這是弓漿蟲淋巴結炎的典型線索之一。
features: Sharp interface between a zone of small mature lymphocytes (left) and a zone of larger activated cells (right)
Right zone composed of centroblast-like and centrocyte-like cells with vesicular nuclei, mitotic figures and apoptotic debris, consistent with a hyperplastic germinal center
Small loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei within the lymphoid area
No well-formed granulomas, necrosis or multinucleated giant cells
Scattered small vessels; no organisms identifiable at this magnification
describe_en: H&E section of lymph node shows a hyperplastic germinal center with centroblasts, mitoses and apoptotic debris, sharply demarcated from a surrounding zone of small lymphocytes. Small, poorly formed clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are present within the lymphoid tissue, without necrosis or giant cells. Organisms are not identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with toxoplasma lymphadenitis (Piringer-Kuchinka pattern), in which follicular hyperplasia, small epithelioid histiocyte clusters and monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia form the diagnostic triad; confirm with Toxoplasma serology.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma has back-to-back follicles with attenuated mantles, loss of polarization, absent tingible body macrophages and BCL2-positive germinal centers.
These form well-circumscribed granulomas with giant cells and, for mycobacteria, caseating necrosis, rather than small loose epithelioid clusters.
Cat scratch disease shows stellate suppurative necrotizing granulomas with neutrophils, which are absent here.

ddx.dx: Lymphocyte-rich classic Hodgkin lymphoma or NLPHL with epithelioid histiocytes
ddx.vs: These contain CD30/CD15-positive Hodgkin cells or CD20-positive LP cells, which are not seen among the histiocyte clusters.
